subject: Re: CBD kickoff — fixing tail-class accuracy on long-tailed workloads
body:
Decision checkpoint, three weeks out.

Results: workload #1 cleared the bar decisively — +7.2 tail accuracy, 0.4 head regression. Fumiko's breakdown shows the gains concentrated exactly where the review-escalation volume is, which makes the OKR story clean. Wanjiru's sharded sampler held up, stage-two epochs back within 15% of baseline speed.

Decisions:
1) Workload #1: GO. Linnea hands the recipe to the owning team next week with Fumiko's eval pack.
2) Workload #2: we started late because of the sampler work, so it becomes the first Q3 item under the scale-up budget rather than rushing a half-validated result by Jun 1. Scope cut, deliberate.
3) iNaturalist18 reproduction (landed within CI of published) goes in the internal tech report for credibility.

Nice work all.
Zofia
